prompt_text: Who is the best healthcare marketing agency in St. Louis?
answer_verbatim:
There’s no single objectively “best” healthcare marketing agency in St. Louis — the right one depends on your organization’s size, goals, budget, specialties (hospitals vs. clinics vs. medical device vs. pharma), and whether you need local-market tactics or national reach.

To help you quickly find the best fit, tell me a few details (one-line answers are fine):
- What type of healthcare organization are you? (hospital system, private practice, clinic, med device, payer, etc.)
- Primary goals (patient acquisition, physician referrals, brand awareness, product launch, telehealth uptake, etc.)
- Monthly/annual marketing budget (ballpark)
- Preferred services (digital ads, SEO/content, branding, PR, social, patient reputation management, telehealth marketing, creative, analytics)
- Any timeline or must-have compliance needs (HIPAA experience, state-specific rules)

Meanwhile, here are practical tips and an evaluation checklist you can use right away:

Where to find candidates
- Search reviews/directories: Clutch, UpCity, DesignRush, Google Maps, LinkedIn
- Look for case studies showing results for healthcare clients
- Ask local healthcare colleagues for referrals

Must-have qualifications
- Demonstrated healthcare experience and HIPAA/compliance knowledge
- Measurable case studies (CAC, CPL, appointment conversion, ROI)
- EMR/PMS / scheduling integration experience (if patient acquisition is a goal)
- Understanding of local referral patterns and regulations

Questions to ask agencies
- Have you worked with organizations like ours? Can you show specific results?
- How do you handle HIPAA and patient data security?
- What KPIs will you track and how often will we receive reports?
- What’s your onboarding process and timeline for results?
- Who will be on our account team and what are their healthcare credentials?

KPIs to expect them to provide
- Cost per lead / Cost per appointment
- Conversion rate (lead → scheduled appointment)
- Organic search rankings and traffic improvements
- ROI / revenue per campaign (if trackable)
- Patient acquisition by channel

Red flags
- No healthcare references or no case studies with metrics
- Vague answers about compliance or data security
- No clear reporting cadence or ownership of results

If you want, give me the details I asked for and I’ll create a short, prioritized list of St. Louis agencies that fit your needs, plus an outreach email and an RFP/question checklist to send them.
